a7380.speech: Listed CDC first-year and handover achievements - constructing more than 75 kilometers of community roads, placing more than 2,300 health workers on the payroll, raising doctors' salaries from US$700 to US$2000, free tuition, increasing domestic revenue to US$640 million, stabilizing the exchange rate and inflation, handing over Net International Reserves of US$240 million and growth of more than 4.5 percent, and passing the MCC scorecard three times - and said that in contrast the Unity Party "inherited a stable and growing economy but has squandered this opportunity," with no projects implemented in its first year, a sharp decline in fiscal transparency, more than 1,000 workers illegally dismissed due to perceived political affiliation, misinformation to the IMF on the wage bill, scholarship and investment scandals, and illegal budget manipulations and procurement violations.

a7380.speaker: Coalition for Democratic Change (CDC) (official response to the State of the Nation Address)
a7380.speech: Said the Unity Party Government's mismanagement of the national budget "has resulted in severe inequities in resource allocation," with senior officials enjoying exorbitant allowances while healthcare, agriculture and education remain critically underfunded, and the nation's 23 public referral hospitals serving over 5.2 million citizens lacking essential medical supplies and with unpaid health workers.

a7380.speaker: Coalition for Democratic Change (CDC) (official response to the State of the Nation Address)
a7380.speech: Described a "Parade of Investment Deception": that 2024 saw no new foreign direct investment but rather 'investment by showmanship'; that the HPX and Guma Africa Group partnership promising $3 billion to $5 billion for the Liberty Corridor "is still hanging"; that the July 15 parade of 285 earth-moving machines had "no signed contract, no formal agreement, and no financial commitment" and that the machines valued at US$80 million are really worth around US$20 million with the remaining US$60 million being "kickbacks for officials of Government"; that the June 24 display of two Marcopolo buses with promises of 300 more in 40 days was "Vlah"; that the announced $3 billion China oil refinery memorandum was inflated, with grants worth roughly US$28 million, a debt waiver of a mere US$900,000, and food assistance of less than US$5 million rather than US$30 million; and that the claimed $500 million MCC grant was dismantled by the MCC's own statement.

a7380.speaker: Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC) (statement)
a7380.speech: Released a statement calmly dismantling the government's claim: there was no grant, no $500 million, and no MCC compact funding, and eligibility does not guarantee a Compact as the government propagated.

a7380.speaker: U.S. Department of State 2024 Fiscal Transparency Report
a7380.speech: Highlighted a sharp decline in fiscal transparency in Liberia during year one of the Unity Party administration.

a7380.speaker: World Bank 2024 economic report
a7380.speech: Cited as showing that the CDC handed the Unity Party a declining poverty profile, while the same report for 2017 showed the CDC inherited an increasing poverty profile in 2018.

a7380.speaker: Coalition for Democratic Change (CDC) (official response to the State of the Nation Address)
a7380.speech: Said it "welcomes the fight against corruption but such a fight cannot be on a selective basis," accusing the UP Government of witch-hunting former CDC officials while leaving unaddressed corruption cases involving tens of millions of US dollars at the National Port Authority, Liberia Revenue Authority, Ministry of Public Works, LRRRC, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Finance and Development Planning, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Central Bank of Liberia, Liberia Telecommunications Authority and Ministry of Agriculture; said the Government both appoints and fights the Ombudsman, so "your fight against corruption is insincere, partisan and unserious," and that the Asset Recovery program has failed.

a7380.speaker: Coalition for Democratic Change (CDC) (official response to the State of the Nation Address)
a7380.speech: Publicly warned the UP Government to desist from misinformation and propaganda, listing its dangers: eroding public trust, damaging credibility through false claims like those surrounding the MCC and China deals, and widening inequality; said "Governance is not about grand announcements or carefully staged parades; it is about delivering real results for the people," and that "Truth is not just a virtue; it is the foundation of democracy."

a7380.speaker: Coalition for Democratic Change (CDC) (official response to the State of the Nation Address)
a7380.speech: Said it sees no progress in health, education and agriculture; that health workers have threatened to strike because the basic salary structure agreed with the CDC administration has been denied them, that volunteer health workers and teachers have not been added to the payroll, and that the legislature's US$2.4 million appropriation to resolve these issues was misused by the UP Government for something else; said the Government is yet to show serious leadership in infrastructure and that most financing for road and electricity projects was secured by the CDC administration.

a7380.speaker: Coalition for Democratic Change (CDC) (official response to the State of the Nation Address)
a7380.speech: Said the biggest failure has been in reconciliation and national unity, shown by the absence of representatives, Senators and Supreme Court justices at the SONA; urged "President Boakai, take charge, Liberia is bleeding," and called on the President to call for a national dialogue on reconciliation and unity, reaching out to former national leaders, all political parties, religious leaders and the international community.

a7380.speaker: Coalition for Democratic Change (CDC) (official response to the State of the Nation Address)
a7380.speech: In closing, stood "resolute in our assertion that 2024 will be remembered as the year of 'Squandered Opportunities' under President Boakai's leadership"; said the attempt to illegally remove the duly elected Speaker "is a chilling example of how far this administration is willing to go to consolidate power"; demanded immediate action and "a comprehensive plan to restore the rule of law, to reinstate democratic principles, and to eradicate corruption at every level of government"; and said that as the leading opposition movement the CDC "stands united with other opposition parties in our resolve to demand accountability, justice, and genuine progress."

a7496.speaker: A specialist well versed in American affairs (anonymous)
a7496.speech: states that "A return of Trump would mean a reduction of American involvement in everything multilateral, such as the climate question, and possibly a reduction in development aid."

a7496.speaker: Numerous analysts
a7496.speech: announce that a return of Trump to power would bring a new springtime of dictatorships on the black continent, considering that "African authoritarian regimes will easily be able to openly renew ties with Russia and China."

a7496.speaker: Donald Trump, former US President and Republican candidate
a7496.speech: described African countries as "shithole countries" during his first term.

a7496.speaker: General Charles de Gaulle
a7496.speech: said "States have no friends, they have only interests."
